notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 public handle-decoding slice to the official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. Each service first enforces connection and joined-federate lifecycle state, then delegates to the matching private typed codec. The Catch2 case proves the required NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember boundaries, round-trips an actual federation-scoped handle from every covered category, and rejects malformed empty encodings with CouldNotDecode. It does not establish cross-RTI encoding interoperability, validate a decoded identity against every execution directory, add remote transport, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or claim conformance.
